1.1.1.2-f3.accuracy_reason: The line is Aeneid 6.743. In Anchises' speech, manes there means the punishment or purgation each soul suffers after death. Burton does widen it to everyday infirmities.

The words 'that of Hesiod' can't be checked here because Burton's lead-in is cut off in the excerpt, but the sidenote 'Oper. & dies.' confirms the source.
